Legal

Privacy Policy

Lux Oasis Interiors & Renovation · A division of Lux Oasis Advisory & Services LLC

01Who We Are

Lux Oasis Interiors & Renovation is a service line of Lux Oasis Advisory & Services LLC, a company registered in the Sharjah Free Zone, United Arab Emirates. We provide renovation project management for property investors, holiday home owners and short-term-rental operators in Dubai. We are project managers and coordinators; the construction work itself is carried out by licensed contractors and specialist trades.

For anything related to this policy, contact us at info@luxoasisadvisory.com.

02What Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect:

  • Contact details — your name, email address, phone or WhatsApp number.
  • Property details — the building, unit type, size, current condition, photographs, drawings or handover documents you choose to send us.
  • Project requirements — the scope you want, your budget range, your timing, and how the unit is or will be used.
  • Records of our communications with you by email or WhatsApp.

We do not collect or store payment card details on this website. The payback estimator on the home page runs entirely in your browser: the numbers you type into it are never sent to us or to anyone else. Our services are not directed at minors and we do not knowingly collect information from them.

03How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Understand your property and respond to your enquiry.
  • Prepare a scope, an indicative budget and a programme for the work.
  • Coordinate the project — briefing contractors, suppliers and consultants with the information they need to quote and to build.
  • Communicate with you throughout the project and at handover.
  • Meet our legal, accounting and tax obligations.

Your information is never sold, and it is never used for third-party advertising.

04How We Share Information

Renovation project management involves other parties by its nature. We share only what is necessary:

  • With contractors, specialist trades, suppliers and consultants who need the property and scope details in order to quote for or carry out the work.
  • With building management, owners' associations or authorities where an approval or a permit requires it.
  • With service providers who help us run our own business, such as communication and file storage tools.
  • With authorities, where we are legally required to do so.

We share the minimum needed for each purpose, and everyone we work with is bound by confidentiality obligations.

05Data Retention

  • Project records: retained for the duration of the project plus 3 years, so that we can answer questions about work that was carried out.
  • Enquiries that do not become projects: retained for 2 years.
  • Deletion: you can request deletion at any time by email to info@luxoasisadvisory.com.

06Your Rights

You have the right to request access to your data, correction, erasure, restriction of processing and portability, and to object to processing. We respond to all such requests within 30 days.

07Cookies

Our use of cookies is minimal and limited to analytics only. We do not use advertising cookies. Web fonts on this site are loaded from Google Fonts, which means your browser makes a request to Google's servers when you open the page.

08Data Security

We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect the information you send us, including access control on the accounts and storage we use. No system can offer an absolute guarantee of security, and we do not claim one.

09International Transfers

Data is processed in the United Arab Emirates. Where data is transferred internationally — for example to a supplier sourcing an item from abroad — appropriate safeguards are applied.

10Changes to This Policy

If we make material changes to this policy, active clients will be notified by email.
